title: Sardine and beetroot salad
summary: Sardine and beetroot salad is a british dinner built around sardines in spring water and cooked beetroot, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Sardine and beetroot salad chopped before the pan goes on. Pat sardines in spring water dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook sardines in spring water until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook cooked beetroot and rocket until hot and lightly browned. Return sardines in spring water and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Sardine and beetroot salad, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.
steps.tip: Taste Sardine and beetroot salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
